cohort: 120 pregnant women aged 20-40 years with eclampsia or severe pre-eclampsia.
finding: Magnesium sulphate treatment resulted in seizure control and decreased maternal mortality.
mod_finding: 75 (62.5%) women had vaginal deliveries and 45 (37.5%) women had cesarean sections.
followup_time: 48 hours after treatment/24 hours after delivery/last convulsion
